s: a bike shop, hire fleet and café at the heart of New Forest riding
w: A bike shop and hire outfit in Lyndhurst, the New Forest's unofficial capital, built around gravel and adventure riding straight out onto the forest's mix of ancient woodland and open heath. The café is, by the shop's own description, "the jewel in the crown" -- proper coffee and generous food for riders heading out to or back from the trails.
_facts: Located at 56 High Street, Lyndhurst, New Forest National Park, Hampshire SO43 7BG
Combines bike sales, hire (gravel, mountain and e-bikes) and repairs with a café
Specialises in bikepacking, gravel and adventure cycling
Lyndhurst is considered the New Forest's principal village
